scenario: Deploy AI to assist recruitment screening for a large private employer
purpose: Review a high-impact employment AI use before deployment.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, Annex III high-risk employment rules are applicable. Deployment should remain under accountable review with human-oversight and current GDPR DPIA controls; this case does not assume Article 27 FRIA applies to every private employer.

scenario: Deploy AI to assist creditworthiness decisions
purpose: Review a consequential financial decision system.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, the relevant Annex III regime is applicable. The creditworthiness scenario is within a category for which Article 27 FRIA duties can apply to covered deployers, alongside human oversight and GDPR DPIA controls.

scenario: Deploy AI by a private entity providing a public service to assist access decisions
purpose: Review an AI system used by a private entity providing a public service that can materially affect individuals.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, the relevant Annex III regime is applicable. A covered private entity providing public services should complete applicable FRIA, DPIA and oversight controls before deployment.

scenario: Deploy AI to rank employees for promotion decisions at a private company
purpose: Review a consequential workplace AI use.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, Annex III workplace high-risk rules are applicable. Deployment should remain under accountable review with human oversight and current GDPR DPIA controls; this case does not assume Article 27 FRIA applies to every private employer.

scenario: Deploy AI by a public education authority to assess exam outcomes
purpose: Review a consequential education AI use by a public-law body.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, the relevant Annex III education regime is applicable. A public-law deployer should complete applicable FRIA, DPIA and human-oversight controls before deployment.

scenario: A high-risk AI system begins producing unexpected harmful recommendations
purpose: Suspend or control use and escalate the identified risk.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, applicable Annex III deployer monitoring duties are in effect. Potential harmful operation should be escalated through accountable human oversight rather than autonomous continuation.

scenario: A deployer detects a serious incident associated with a high-risk AI system
purpose: Coordinate provider and authority notification under applicable obligations.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, applicable Annex III deployer obligations are in effect. A serious-incident scenario requires accountable escalation and assessment of the precise notification duties.

scenario: Monitoring shows a high-risk AI system is being used outside its intended purpose
purpose: Escalate misuse and reassess deployment.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, applicable Annex III deployer monitoring duties are in effect. Material misuse requires accountable escalation and reassessment.

scenario: High-risk AI input data drift materially changes the population represented
purpose: Review representativeness and safe continued use.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, the applicable Annex III regime is in effect. Material input-data drift should be reviewed before continued consequential use.

scenario: A high-risk AI system cannot provide required operational logs after an incident
purpose: Escalate traceability and compliance failure.
provisional_rationale: At the 2027-12-03 evaluation date, the applicable Annex III deployer regime is in effect. Loss of required operational traceability should be escalated for accountable investigation.
